description: Pete and Myka are introduced to Warehouse 13 and its dangerous collection, learning artifact retrieval while MacPherson turns the Warehouse’s own history into a growing threat.

s01e01.description: In “Pilot”, Pete, Myka and the Warehouse team confront another artifact-driven crisis, racing to identify the object and contain its effects before the damage spreads.
